def get_mu_and_sigma_of_lognormal(mean, cov):
    """ Calculate the parameters mu and sigma of a log-normal distribution given its mean and coefficient of variation (cov).

        Parameters
        ----------
        mean : float
            Mean of the log-normal distribution.
        
        cov : float
            Coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by mean) of the log-normal distribution.

        Returns
        -------
        mu : float
            The mu parameter of the log-normal distribution.
        
        sigma : float
            The sigma parameter of the log-normal distribution.
    """
    sigma = np.sqrt(np.log(1 + cov**2))
    mu = np.log(mean) - 0.5 * sigma**2
    return mu, sigma
